normative_statements: This is the versioned 6.2 evidence-applicability and mandatory-gap decision authorized by the Project Owner task. It consumes frozen 6.1 and applies the frozen GAPS criteria without changing their text. No legal/privacy/security approval or runtime acceptance is asserted.

Each gap has exactly one disposition. blocking identifies the exact future boundary named in its deadline; blocks_6_3 independently identifies minimum admission predecessors. An accepted reusable-evidence row does not discharge separately listed product integration obligations.

Implementation and acceptance are separate. Before affected code: approve exact design/data/artifact/protocol prerequisites stated per row. During implementation acceptance: prove actual behavior on the actual build. All implementation still waits for 6.3; no downstream task is started here. This is an explicit prospective first-Alpha sequencing overlay on the older broad readiness/Technical Plan Stage 0-before-production language, not a retrospective full-MVP PoC waiver.

Capture exploratory evidence is enough to begin the bounded Stage 8 path only after 6.3 and GAP-CAP-02/GAP-REC-02 pre-code requirements. Clean 3600-s screen-off and POCO/OEM proof are mandatory at 8.6, not before coding. No 8-hour stability, all-OEM or production capture claim is made.

VAD host mechanics may be reused. Artifact, profile and governed corpus decisions must precede8.4 acoustic implementation; physical acoustic/realtime proof is mandatory at 8.4/8.6 acceptance. No acoustic campaign or invented production threshold occurs now.

Search supports a bounded lexical implementation path after 6.3 and exact product dependency/schema/protocol admission. The actual 10.2/10.3C build must pass correctness, 10k/1M latency and storage/update predicates. SEARCH_V2 is prospective Stage 0 evidence only; the Alpha protocol must bind its predicates or an explicit prospective replacement before measurement. No blanket Stage 0C rerun and no automatic FTS4 production admission.

Energy comparator mechanics do not prove energy. Capture-first/no-concurrent-heavy-ML remains the safe default until applicable evidence. Freeze scheduling and measurement/aggregation/trace decisions before affected implementation/measurement; physical capture/VAD energy and thermal evidence is required at 8.6, integrated workloads by 12.1 before 12.4. Unknown mWh/aggregation/fallback cannot become PASS.

Offline is ten independent behavioral obligations, not one PASS. No model never blocks recording. Local use is conditional on installation, while install/removal/integrity and Cloud-only acceptance remain required. No-account/no-GMS independence remains IN and needs actual attributable evidence; limited POCO support does not silently waive it. Full historical D4/D1-D7 support and deferred tasks/diarization/LLM flows are outside first-Alpha scope.

Reuse accepted Recovery 0D.6 exactly: ALPHA CLOSED/FULL OPEN; preserve historical full FAIL, expected-negative FAIL and STREAM K12 raw FAIL plus separate reassessment. No Recovery run or PR #86 operation. Product integration, consumer permissions, ADR-AUDIO and dependency admission remain separately gated.

Reuse Stage 5 exact Small q8_0/whisper.cpp/POCO/RU+EN boundary. No new model run, timestamps, mixed-language, actual 16KiB-device or all-device claim. Private data/retention and historical ASR failures are unchanged.

Only CLD-ADM-GAPS-001 changes from the effective 6.1 overlay: OPEN to SATISFIED. Frozen 6.2C remains byte-identical. AWS stays SELECTED_ALPHA_PLATFORM; technical admission NOT_RUN; first real audio NOT_READY; Cloud runtime NOT_IMPLEMENTED; Cloud Alpha acceptance NOT_RUN; 6.2D and 6.3 BLOCKED. All frozen first-audio gates and 14 Alpha exits remain mandatory.

Closure PASS requires successful docs validation, one atomic docs-only commit, push, exact remote HEAD and all changed Google Sheet cells read back. The final task report and Sheet bind the post-publication receipt; this pre-commit file does not self-certify future external writes. If publication/readback fails, report PARTIAL/BLOCKED rather than completed PASS.
